messages:
maya: Quick note — running through the runtime quickstart and the example cURL is hitting a 403. looks like the upstream design doc moved to a private repo and the URL now 403s. staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#auth :grimacing:
ton y: ugh. which file path is this in? i can grab the line and open a PR if it's a one-liner.
maya: file is `docs/runtime/quickstart.md`. the snippet references `https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth` in the example header. exact block:
```
curl -X POST 
  'https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/generate' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' 
  -H 'Referer: https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth' 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
we should either rehost that design doc under docs (preferred) or remove the referer header sample.
doc-scan-bot: Link scanner: 1 broken external link detected in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` (https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth) — flagged at 2026-03-21T14:02:12Z.
tony: can we just change the header line to `-H 'Referer: https://docs.redwood.com/designs/api-v1/auth'` as a temporary fix? or do we want to rehost the content inside our KB and point there? :eyes:
eli: I can rehost a minimal excerpt under `docs/kb/designs/api-auth` and add a short note. then we can point the referer there. if someone wants the full internal design, we can link privately. i'll draft the MD and open a PR.
jen: heads up — if we rehost, we need an i18n follow-up. `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` is included in the ja runtime guide. localization folks will need the new string. can we keep the text minimal to avoid big translation churn?
maya: yep keep it tiny. just the auth caveat + example redirect is enough. eli, if you can do the PR include a one-line changelog entry and ping `#i18n` after merge.
tony: i'll run a quick grep to make sure this referer isn't duplicated elsewhere. fyi `rg "internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1" -n docs || true`
tony: grep found two hits: `docs/runtime/quickstart.md:42` and `docs/examples/websocket-auth.md:18`. we should patch both.
eli: i'll patch both in one PR. proposed commit message: "docs: rehost auth caveat and replace internal referer links". PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/???? (will fill).
maya: awesome. small ask for reviewer: double-check the curl sample still produces a 200 on staging after the change.
doc-scan-bot: Reminder: after merge run `doc-scan-bot rescan docs/runtime/quickstart.md` to clear the flagged item.
jen: tagging product writers: @maya @eli please add a one-line note to the release notes that this is a docs-only rehost (no product change). :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — marking this as assigned to eli. ping me when PR is ready and i'll do the quick staging test.
eli: will do, aiming to open the PR in the next hour.
tony: :thumbsup:
